schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Group the Go toolchain and stdlib-adjacent bumps into one PR.
Mantine ships its packages in lockstep; splitting them breaks the build.
React and its types move together.
Playwright's npm package and its browser bundle are versioned together.
One PR for all GitHub Actions bumps; they are low-risk and noisy apart.
Non-major npm updates in one weekly PR; majors stay separate.
Keep mise's own tool pins current (go, node, java, gradle, golangci-lint…).
The Go version in mise.toml, go.mod and the Dockerfile must move together.

The vendored Suwayomi source tree (extensions/vendir.yml). A bump here changes the fake-Android runtime the extension sidecar is built on, so it is reviewed on its own and gated by the sidecar contract tests in CI.
vendir is pinned twice (mise.toml for local builds, extensions/Dockerfile for the image); bump both together.
Gradle is pinned in mise.toml, the wrapper and the sidecar image's build stage. Matched by dependency name: the three managers resolve it through different packages.
One lock file maintenance PR, not one per group above (the manager-wide groups would otherwise each claim their own).
Majors are reviewed one at a time — they are the ones that break the build.

customManagers.description: The vendir release extensions/Dockerfile downloads to sync the vendored Suwayomi tree. mise.toml pins the same tool for local builds; both move in the one "vendir" PR.
